messages:
Hannah Lee: Quick SEO rundown for the LLM launch and webinar next week. Need owners for keywords, schema, internal linking, redirects, and GTM/form wiring.
Diego Ramos: I’ll own keyword targets + meta templates. 1 primary + 2 long-tail per page. Sheet by Wed.
Priya Patel: I’ll do JSON-LD for WebinarEvent + FAQPage and run Rich Results tests. Will push snippets to staging.
Marcus Shaw: Redirects here — three legacy docs moved to /docs/platform. I’ll prepare CSV + Netlify/NGINX examples. Will stage as 302 then swap to 301 after QA.
Hannah Lee: @Diego include utm examples (utm_source, utm_medium, utm_campaign). @Priya mirror FAQ answers to page copy for consistent snippets. @Marcus add curl/status checks in PR.
Diego Ramos: Suggested keywords — landing: "low-latency LLM inference"; supports: "inference latency optimization", "production LLM serving". Webinar: "LLM serving webinar", long-tail: "reduce inference cost", "prefix caching for LLMs".
Priya Patel: JSON-LD draft for staging: ```{"@context":"https://schema.org","@type":"Event","name":"Running LLMs in Production","startDate":"2026-04-07T16:00:00Z","location":{"@type":"VirtualLocation","url":"https://redwood.ai/webinars/llm-inference"},"offers":{"@type":"Offer","url":"https://redwood.ai/register"}}```
Marcus Shaw: NGINX example: rewrite ^/docs/old-serve/?$ /docs/platform/serving/ permanent;
Hannah Lee: GTM/form: hidden field campaign=llm_launch_apr26 and fire event webinar_signup. SalesOps wants lead_source populated; pass utm_content when from benchmark blog.
seo-bot: Reminder: run Structured Data test + Lighthouse on staging after schema is live.
Diego Ramos: Internal linking plan: add contextual links from docs overview, performance page, and two benchmark posts. I’ll include anchor text suggestions in the sheet.
Priya Patel: QA checklist: Structured Data validator, Rich Results screenshot, SERP meta preview, accessibility smoke test.
Marcus Shaw: Will open PR with redirect CSV + temporary 302 rules by EoD.
Hannah Lee: Owners & deadlines: Diego -> keywords + metas by Wed (1759980000). Priya -> schema + tests by Mon (1760112800). Marcus -> redirects + PR by Fri EOD (1760056400). Review meeting scheduled after assets are in. Ping here for blockers. :rocket:
